title: Fix stuck ViewActivationOverlay that blocks Landing page interaction

requirements.text: Prevent ViewActivationOverlay from appearing (or remaining active) on non-target views so the Landing page is always visible and clickable. The overlay must only render when the currently-rendered view matches the activation target (e.g., only show for dashboard activation while the Dashboard view is actually mounted).
acceptanceCriteria: When the app is on Landing or About, there is no fullscreen overlay element intercepting clicks (no dark/transparent layer blocking interaction).
If an activation for Dashboard is started but the user navigates to Landing/About (or logs out) before it finishes, the overlay immediately disappears and does not reappear.
Reproducing the reported state (“only About button works”) is no longer possible; all Landing CTAs/links/buttons remain clickable.

requirements.text: Harden the view-activation lifecycle so activation always finishes reliably: ensure activation is cancelled on any navigation away from the target view and finished when the target view has rendered and its initial critical loading has settled (including Dashboard loading states).
acceptanceCriteria: Starting navigation to Dashboard triggers activation, and the overlay is removed automatically once Dashboard has rendered and initial queries have settled (success or error).
Navigating away from Dashboard (to Landing/About) always cancels activation immediately (no lingering activation state).
Logging out always cancels activation and leaves the app in a fully interactive Landing view.

requirements.text: Add defensive safeguards against “stuck” activation state: ensure any safety timeout cleanup cannot leave a stale activation that blocks interaction, and add minimal instrumentation (console debug logs guarded by a development check) to trace start/finish/cancel transitions during development builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Activation state cannot remain true beyond the configured safety timeout for the same target; after timeout, overlay is not rendered and clicks work normally.
In development mode, start/finish/cancel/timeout events are logged with the current target and current view to aid debugging; no noisy logs in production build.
No React warnings/errors are introduced (e.g., due to timers updating state after unmount).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components).
Do not modify immutable hook/provider files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep backend unchanged unless strictly necessary; this fix should be achievable in frontend view/overlay logic.
Maintain the single-actor Motoko architecture (no new backend services).
nonGoals: Redesigning the Landing page content or adding new product features.
Adding new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Implementing missing placeholder pages/components (AdminPanel, ResultPage, TestInterface, PDF export placeholders) unless required to resolve the overlay regression.
